aicodingdaily.name: AI Coding Daily LLM Coding Leaderboard
aicodingdaily.metric: Total points (max 80); best reported reasoning setting per model

swe_bench_verified.name: SWE-bench Verified
swe_bench_verified.metric: % resolved, as published by the vendor or leaderboard

livecodebench.name: LiveCodeBench
livecodebench.metric: Mean pass@1 over the 1055 questions the leaderboard ran each model on, from the LiveCodeBench team's own per-question results file

aider_polyglot.name: Aider Polyglot
aider_polyglot.metric: Percent correct over the 225 polyglot coding exercises, run by aider with the edit format that scores best for that model

bfcl.name: Berkeley Function Calling Leaderboard v4
bfcl.metric: Overall Accuracy: the unweighted average of all BFCL sub-categories (Agentic, Multi-Turn, Live, Non-Live, Hallucination), native function-calling mode where the model has one

gpqa_diamond.name: GPQA Diamond
gpqa_diamond.metric: Accuracy on the 198-question GPQA-Diamond set, re-run by Vals AI on its own archived leaderboard, one harness for every model in the table

hle.name: Humanity's Last Exam
hle.metric: Score on HLE as listed by the llm-stats benchmark table; each row keeps the vendor's or llm-stats' own wording, which says whether tools were allowed

tau_bench.name: tau-bench (airline + retail + telecom)
tau_bench.metric: pass^1 averaged over the three original tau-bench domains, from the official submission files on taubench.com (tau-bench 0.1.3, the same three tasks per model)

aa_gpqa.name: GPQA Diamond (Artificial Analysis run)
aa_gpqa.metric: Accuracy on GPQA Diamond as run by Artificial Analysis; their data API reports a 0-1 fraction, stored here x100. One of AA's earlier Intelligence Index components, not one of the ten evaluations in v4.3.2. Source: Artificial Analysis data API https://artificialanalysis.ai/api/v2/data/llms/models (fetched 2026-10-24); their own standardised harness, one setting per model.

aa_hle.name: Humanity's Last Exam (Artificial Analysis run)
aa_hle.metric: Open-answer score on HLE's 2,158 questions, 1 sample, no tools, Equality Checker LLM pass@1, run by Artificial Analysis; in Intelligence Index v4.3.2 at 10%. API reports a 0-1 fraction, stored here x100. Source: Artificial Analysis data API https://artificialanalysis.ai/api/v2/data/llms/models (fetched 2026-10-24); their own standardised harness, one setting per model.

aa_lcr.name: AA-LCR v1.1 long-context reasoning (Artificial Analysis run)
aa_lcr.metric: Open-answer score on AA-LCR v1.1 (100 long-context reasoning items, 3 samples, Equality Checker LLM pass@1), built and run by Artificial Analysis; in Intelligence Index v4.3.2 at 5%. API reports a 0-1 fraction, stored here x100. Source: Artificial Analysis data API https://artificialanalysis.ai/api/v2/data/llms/models (fetched 2026-10-24); their own standardised harness, one setting per model.

aa_ifbench.name: IFBench instruction following (Artificial Analysis run)
aa_ifbench.metric: Score on IFBench (294 items, 5 samples, rule-driven extraction pass@1, no tools), run by Artificial Analysis; one of their additional evaluations outside the Intelligence Index. API reports a 0-1 fraction, stored here x100. Source: Artificial Analysis data API https://artificialanalysis.ai/api/v2/data/llms/models (fetched 2026-10-24); their own standardised harness, one setting per model.

aa_tau2.name: tau2-bench agentic tool use (Artificial Analysis run)
aa_tau2.metric: pass^1-style agentic tool-use score from Artificial Analysis' tau2-bench run (their additional evaluations). The task set and domain differ from our tau_bench anchor column (tau-bench 0.1.3, three domains), so the two are kept as separate benchmarks. API reports a 0-1 fraction, stored here x100. Source: Artificial Analysis data API https://artificialanalysis.ai/api/v2/data/llms/models (fetched 2026-10-24); their own standardised harness, one setting per model.

aa_tau_banking.name: tau-Banking agentic agent (Artificial Analysis run)
aa_tau_banking.metric: Score on the Banking agent evaluation (97 tasks, 5 samples, dual-control agent-user simulation with knowledge retrieval, backend database state pass@1) as listed in Artificial Analysis' additional evaluations. API reports a 0-1 fraction, stored here x100. Source: Artificial Analysis data API https://artificialanalysis.ai/api/v2/data/llms/models (fetched 2026-10-24); their own standardised harness, one setting per model.
